name: feasibility_restricted_gaussian_rank_permutation
initialization: Ascending FEV1 paired with ascending FVC.
primary_law: Within each sex, assign standard-normal midrank scores to both marginal grids. Starting from the identity permutation, perform sweeps*m symmetric random transposition proposals. Reject any proposal violating FEV1 <= FVC. Otherwise use a Metropolis acceptance probability targeting permutation mass proportional to exp(rho/(1-rho^2) * sum_i z_i*z_p[i]). The finite-step output is the specified generator; equilibrium is not asserted.
interpretation: A strongly positively associated, feasibility-restricted pairing scenario. The latent rank parameter is an explicit modeling assumption, not an estimated volume correlation.
weighting: Construct each sex separately. Use weight 1/(2*m_sex) per row for population summaries, regardless of source sample sizes.
